g.text: Historical four-arm SFT and RAG comparison
Historical matched 21-example SFT experiment; motor test n=76 (67 answerable, 9 unanswerable).
Qwen and Ministral share each model’s own checkpoint between base and SFT. No new interim-data SFT result.
